newsitem.title: UK: C&W up after gains by HK Telecom shares.
newsitem.headline: C&W up after gains by HK Telecom shares.

text.p: Shares in Cable and Wireless Plc rose in a declining market on Thursday after a strong overnight performance by Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd, in which C&W holds a 59 percent stake, traders said.
The stock was up 3-1/2p at 478-1/2 by 1056 GMT.
Hong Kong Telecom rose HK$0.30 to HK$12.80 in Hong Kong despite a 1.91 percent fall in the Hang Seng index.
Traders said HK Telecom was boosted by the issue of 380 million call warrants on its shares, as well as market talk about a possible deal with Singapore Telecom.
"Cable and Wireless is up after a good performance by Hong Kong Telecom. There have been rumours swirling around about Singapore Telecom taking a stake in Hong Kong Telecom," one market-maker said.
"There's been a bit of speculation about what's going to happen with Cable and Wireless's stake in Hong Kong Telecom," said another market-maker.
A spokesman for Cable and Wireless declined to comment on the speculation.
